text:
maria: FYI — audit schema change going out in tonight's deploy. Need quick alignment on what we expose in customer exports (tenant visibility)

sam: what's changing exactly? which fields might leak tenant info? :thinking_face:

maria: adding `session_id` and `request_id` at top level and normalizing `actor` into an object. example below:

```
{
  "event_type": "model.generate",
  "timestamp": "2024-06-30T23:40:12Z",
  "actor": { "id": "user:123", "role": "member" },
  "tenant_id": "tenant_abc",
  "resource": { "id": "model:roberta", "owner": "tenant_abc" },
  "metadata": { "prompt_len": 345 }
}
```

alex: we shouldn't include `tenant_id` in any customer-facing export unless the caller proves tenant_admin or presents a tenant-scoped token. For support workflows, prefer tenant-scoped tokens signed by our KMS or customer KMS.

joel: scoped-token note: current support tokens are `support:read:audits` with no tenant baked in. If support needs tenant-scoped access, tokens must include `tenant:XYZ` claim and be KMS-signed. Otherwise redact tenant_id on export.

maria: Proposed rule: default export = redact `tenant_id` and `resource.owner`. Only include them when auth context contains either: 1) tenant_admin role for that tenant OR 2) a tenant-scoped token (`tenant:ID:audits`) validated by KMS. Also add an enterprise opt-in for full unredacted exports (signed + DPA).

sam: what about admin vs member visibility inside the tenant? Members should get events for actions they performed, but admin-only fields (like `impersonation` metadata or internal_kms_ids) should never be sent to members.

alex: KMS integration detail: export manifest should include `kms_key_id` and we should sign the artifact hash. If using customer-managed KMS, require attestation that key is customer-owned before including any tenant identifiers.

joel: vuln check — generation logs sometimes contain full prompt text. For customer exports we must scrub PII by default and provide an explicit enterprise opt-in to include full prompt text with extra consent and audit trail.

maria: Action items (short):
1) RBAC check + default-redact in export handler — owner: sam
2) schema docs + example exports showing redaction — owner: maria
3) add KMS-signing flow and manifest fields — owner: alex
4) redaction config + regression tests + prompt-scrub rules — owner: joel
Can we get these baseline changes before the deploy goes out? :sweat_smile:

sam: I'll push a minimal RBAC patch that redacts `tenant_id`/`resource.owner` by default. PR in ~30m. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll wire KMS signing into the export worker but gate it behind a feature flag. Will add manifest schema and verification call.

security-bot: deploy scheduled: audit-schema-update v3.2 -> prod at 2024-06-30T23:45Z. Oncall notified.

maria: If it's too late for major changes, at minimum ensure default-redact = ON and a hotfix rollback path exists. No customer-facing leak.

joel: also add a regression that simulates a support token without tenant claims and verifies exported ZIP has no tenant identifiers and that archive manifest is signed when required.

sam: noted, adding tests to the PR.

maria: thanks all — ping me on the PRs for quick review. :eyes:
